recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a male subject against a vertical wood-plank background, featuring a high-contrast denim texture and a large-scale, thin-weight geometric sans-serif title anchored at the bottom edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The blue denim jacket provides a cool-toned contrast against the warm, earthy brown of the wooden background.
The white typography cuts through the dark lower portion of the image for maximum legibility.
The vertical lines of the wood paneling mirror the upright posture of the subject.
The subject's direct gaze creates a central focal point that leads the eye down to the wide-set typography.
coreInvariants: Medium wash denim with visible stitching
Ultra-wide tracking on the bottom-aligned text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally framed from the chest up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face is the primary anchor, while the large-scale text at the bottom provides a structural base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the denim jacket, and rests on the wide horizontal text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The wooden background provides textured negative space on either side of the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers from the wood paneling (Background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Indigo and medium blue from the denim (Subject clothing).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the wood tones; high value contrast between the white text and the dark denim.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg
The 'G' is open with a simple horizontal crossbar
The 'E' has equal length horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage; use varying weights if secondary text is needed.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric purity and circular counters.
Classic geometric skeleton with sharp vertices.
Modern, clean sans-serif with wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with light brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a medium-wash denim jacket over a grey t-shirt. He is leaning against a rustic vertical wood-plank wall. Lighting is warm and directional from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single line of large, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the bottom 15% of the frame. The text should be thin-weight and span the entire width of the image, slightly overlapping the subject's torso.

verificationChecks: Does the denim texture look realistic and high-contrast?
Is the font weight consistent across all letters?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Brett Young'
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the individual
Ensure the wood texture is a generic rustic pattern

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the denim and wood

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the denim
Verify the geometric 'O' is a perfect circle
Ensure the subject's eyes are in sharp focus
Confirm the wood planks are straight and vertical
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Geometric Sans Overlay + High-Contrast Texture
